translation.method: AI 專業翻譯（Claude，依網站上下文與學術／運動科技領域用語逐句翻譯）。禁止使用 Google 翻譯或其他機器翻譯服務。

rules: 鍵是頁面上顯示的中文原文（連續空白視為一個空白），值是英文。找不到對應的文字維持中文顯示，不會出錯。
實驗室名稱依 TEACHER_REQUIREMENTS.md A1 一字不差：Human-Centric Superintelligence Innovation Lab。
人名只用本人在成員資料或手機頁填寫的英文名（names 區）；沒有英文名的人維持中文，不自行音譯。
學期代碼換算：民國學年 + 1911 = 秋季學期西元年；第 2 學期為隔年春季（例：1132 學期 = Spring 2025）。
patterns 用於含數字或人名的句子；$1、$2 會先在字典裡找對應英文，找不到則原樣保留。
新增或修改中文內容後，執行 node scripts/i18n-check.mjs（先 npm run build）列出還沒翻譯的文字，交給 AI 翻譯後加進本檔。

page_pi.施老師於國立清華大學電機系取得博士學位，曾任元智大學電機系教授及電機通訊國際學士: Prof. Shih received his Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from National Tsing Hua University. He was a Professor of Electrical Engineering at Yuan Ze University and Director of its International Bachelor Program in Electrical and Communication Engineering, and has been a visiting professor at the University of Washington (USA) and Óbuda University (Hungary). He joined the Department of Information Management at National Central University in 2025. His research focuses on content-based multimedia analysis, sports data analytics, AIoT and human–computer interaction. He has published more than 100 journal and conference papers and holds 7 ROC, 3 US and 2 CN patents. He served as an Associate Editor of IEEE Trans. on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (2022–2025) and is currently an Associate Editor of IEEE Trans. on Consumer Electronics (2026–2027).
